goal: PRD 階段6:Session 式鍵盤延伸(Wispr Flow 架構)——主 App 背景錄音保活,鍵盤延伸當遙控器+直接 insertText 潤飾結果進任何輸入框;iOS 16 相容
preflight_permissions: 新增修改 ios/** 檔案
Drive→mirror 複製並於 mirror commit(push 另請示)

acceptance.desc: B1 xcodebuild -project ios/SaySomething.xcodeproj -scheme SaySomething -sdk iphonesimulator build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO 於 mirror exit 0(App+鍵盤延伸兩 target 皆建置且延伸有 embed)

evidence.cmd: cd ios && xcodebuild -project SaySomething.xcodeproj -scheme SaySomething -sdk iphonesimulator build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

acceptance.desc: B2 鍵盤延伸 target 存在,Info.plist RequestsOpenAccess=YES,IsASCIICapable 等 IME 必要欄位齊備,deployment target 16.0

evidence.cmd: bash -c "grep -q com.apple.keyboard-service ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/Info.plist && grep -A1 RequestsOpenAccess ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/Info.plist | grep -q true && grep -q PrimaryLanguage ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/Info.plist && grep -q IsASCIICapable ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/Info.plist && grep -A20 \"1AAC6B4E0BFE71BF5433DC24 /\\* Debug \\*/\" ios/SaySomething.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj | grep -q \"IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET = 16.0\""

acceptance.desc: B3 主 App Info.plist UIBackgroundModes 含 audio;有背景錄音保活服務(AVAudioEngine 常駐,未擷取時丟棄樣本),由 Darwin notification 觸發開始/停止擷取

evidence.cmd: bash -c "grep -A2 UIBackgroundModes ios/SaySomething/Info.plist | grep -q audio && grep -q AVAudioEngine ios/SaySomething/SessionService.swift && grep -q installTap ios/SaySomething/SessionService.swift && grep -q recordStart ios/SaySomething/SessionService.swift && grep -q recordStop ios/SaySomething/SessionService.swift"

acceptance.desc: B4 鍵盤↔App 通訊:信號走 CFNotificationCenter Darwin notification,資料走 App Group(group.com.saysomething.app)共享容器;並有 named UIPasteboard 降級路徑(App Group 不可用時)

evidence.cmd: bash -c "grep -q CFNotificationCenterGetDarwinNotifyCenter ios/Shared/KeyboardBridge.swift && grep -q group.com.saysomething.app ios/Shared/KeyboardBridge.swift && grep -q group.com.saysomething.app ios/SaySomething/SaySomething.entitlements && grep -q group.com.saysomething.app ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/SaySomethingKeyboard.entitlements && grep -q UIPasteboard ios/Shared/KeyboardBridge.swift && grep -q appGroupWorks ios/Shared/KeyboardBridge.swift"

acceptance.desc: B5 鍵盤以 textDocumentProxy.insertText 插入潤飾結果,並有退格/空白/換行/切換鍵盤(globe)基本鍵

evidence.cmd: bash -c "grep -q textDocumentProxy.insertText ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/KeyboardViewController.swift && grep -q deleteBackward ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/KeyboardViewController.swift && grep -q spaceTapped ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/KeyboardViewController.swift && grep -q enterTapped ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/KeyboardViewController.swift && grep -q advanceToNextInputMode ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/KeyboardViewController.swift && grep -q needsInputModeSwitchKey ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/KeyboardViewController.swift"

acceptance.desc: B6 鍵盤有啟動 session 鈕:responder-chain 開啟 saysomething://session;App 處理該 URL 啟動保活並嘗試私有 API suspend 自動彈回,失敗顯示手動切回提示

evidence.cmd: bash -c "grep -q sel_registerName ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/KeyboardViewController.swift && grep -q saysomething://session ios/Shared/KeyboardBridge.swift && grep -q handleSessionURL ios/SaySomething/SessionService.swift && grep -q handleSessionURL ios/SaySomething/SaySomethingApp.swift && grep -q suspend ios/SaySomething/SessionService.swift && grep -q showManualReturnHint ios/SaySomething/SessionService.swift && grep -q showManualReturnHint ios/SaySomething/ContentView.swift && grep -q saysomething ios/SaySomething/Info.plist"

acceptance.desc: B7 七模式可於鍵盤切換,與 Prompts.swift 同源(不得複製貼上兩份 prompt)

evidence.cmd: test 1 -eq $(find ios -iname Prompts.swift | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && grep -q Prompts.modes ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/KeyboardViewController.swift && grep -q 49951376AE084168B2DE8EDF ios/SaySomething.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj

acceptance.desc: B8 ios/README.md 更新:鍵盤啟用步驟(設定→一般→鍵盤→新增→Full Access)、session 啟動說明、已知限制

evidence.cmd: grep -q 允許完整取用 ios/README.md && grep -q saysomething ios/README.md && grep -q 已知限制 ios/README.md && grep -q 回收 ios/README.md

acceptance.desc: B9 兩 target 的 entitlements 檔含 App Group;主 App 與延伸 bundle id 分別為 com.saysomething.app 與 com.saysomething.app.keyboard

evidence.cmd: grep -q group.com.saysomething.app ios/SaySomething/SaySomething.entitlements && grep -q group.com.saysomething.app ios/SaySomethingKeyboard/SaySomethingKeyboard.entitlements && grep -q 'PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER = com.saysomething.app;' ios/SaySomething.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj && grep -q 'PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER = com.saysomething.app.keyboard;' ios/SaySomething.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj

verify_cmds: xcodebuild -project ios/SaySomething.xcodeproj -scheme SaySomething -sdk iphonesimulator build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
